canvas.$description: Plugin window background, the lowest layer.

surface.$description: Panels and sections placed on the canvas.

inset.$description: Recessed wells: knob and slider tracks, meter backgrounds, displays.

hover.$description: Hover background for controls and rows.

default.$description: Primary text and icons on any bg role.

subtle.$description: Units, tick labels, secondary metadata; not for body text.

disabled.$description: Disabled labels, exempt from contrast targets.

fill.$description: Solid accent background: primary buttons, active toggles, value arcs on inset tracks.

on-fill.$description: Text and icons placed on accent.fill.

fg.$description: Accent text and icons, on bg.surface or on accent.bg.

bg.$description: Quiet accent tint behind accent.fg: selected items, banners.

on-fill.$description: Text and icons placed on danger.fill.

fg.$description: Danger text and icons, on bg.surface or on danger.bg.

bg.$description: Quiet danger tint behind danger.fg, as in an alert.

on-fill.$description: Text and icons placed on success.fill.

fg.$description: Success text and icons, on bg.surface or on success.bg.

bg.$description: Quiet success tint behind success.fg, as in an alert.

on-fill.$description: Text and icons placed on warning.fill.

fg.$description: Warning text and icons, on bg.surface or on warning.bg.

bg.$description: Quiet warning tint behind warning.fg, as in an alert.

scrim.$description: Translucent backdrop behind dialogs and drawers.

constant.$description: Numbers, language constants, constant and object names, CSS properties.

string.$description: Unquoted strings: shell arguments, Markdown code.

keyword.$description: Keywords and storage modifiers, JSON keys.

function.$description: Functions, types and classes, JSX and HTML attributes.

string-expression.$description: Quoted and template strings, regular expressions, tag names.
